summary: Iteration 41: Comprehensive testing of new Lessons V2 module. All 22 backend tests PASSED. Frontend UI fully verified: Staff View with dashboard stats, Create/Upload lesson forms, Lesson Editor with AI Panel, Submit workflow, Management View with Submissions/Compliance/Overdue tabs, Management Review Panel with Evaluate/Approve/Return/Publish buttons.
passed_tests: Backend: Teacher login (edmund@tcis.demo)
Backend: SuperAdmin login (dwain@tcis.demo)
Backend: GET /api/lessons-v2/my-dashboard returns staff stats (total, term_lessons, drafts, submitted, returned, approved)
Backend: GET /api/lessons-v2/ returns teacher's lessons list
Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/ creates new lesson with correct fields
Backend: GET /api/lessons-v2/{id} returns lesson with comments and audit_trail
Backend: PUT /api/lessons-v2/{id} updates lesson and changes status to in_progress
Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/{id}/submit changes status to submitted
Backend: Cannot submit already submitted lesson (400 error)
Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/{id}/review with action=start_review changes status to under_review
Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/{id}/review with action=return changes status to returned
Backend: Teacher can resubmit returned lesson (status=resubmitted)
Backend: GET /api/lessons-v2/management-dashboard returns management stats
Backend: Teacher cannot access management dashboard (403)
Backend: Management can list all submitted lessons
Backend: GET /api/lessons-v2/management/compliance returns teacher compliance data
Backend: Teacher cannot access compliance tracker (403)
Backend: POST /api/lessons-v2/{id}/comments adds comment
Backend: Comments are persisted and returned with lesson
Backend: DELETE /api/lessons-v2/{id} deletes draft lesson
Backend: Deleted lesson returns 404
Frontend: Staff View loads with dashboard stats (Total, This Term, Drafts, Submitted, Returned, Approved)
Frontend: Create New button opens Create Lesson form
Frontend: Create Lesson form has all fields (Title, Subject, Year Group, Term, Duration, Curriculum, Objectives, Description, Classes)
Frontend: Lesson created successfully and opens in Editor
Frontend: Lesson Editor has toolbar (Back, Save, AI Assistant, Submit, Delete)
Frontend: Lesson Editor has tabs (Editor, Issues, Comments, History)
Frontend: AI Assistant panel opens with action buttons (Improve All, TCIS Standard, Expand Weak, Fix Objectives, Add Assessments, Differentiation, Structure Format)
Frontend: Custom AI Command textarea and Run AI Command button visible
Frontend: Upload button opens Upload Lesson form with file drag zone
Frontend: Filter buttons work (All, Drafts, Pending, Returned, Approved)
Frontend: Submit button submits lesson to management
Frontend: Status changes to 'Submitted' after submit
Frontend: Toast notification 'Submitted to management!' shown
Frontend: SuperAdmin sees dual-role tabs (My Lessons, Management Review)
Frontend: Management View shows stats (Total Submitted, Pending Review, Under Review, Approved, Returned)
Frontend: Management Submissions tab shows table with Staff, Subject/Year, Term, Status, Submitted, AI, Action columns
Frontend: Compliance Tracker tab shows teacher compliance table with Required, Submitted, Approved, Missing, Rate columns
Frontend: Overdue Staff tab shows teachers who haven't submitted
Frontend: Clicking lesson row opens Management Review Panel
Frontend: Management Review Panel shows lesson content, metadata, and action buttons
Frontend: Review Panel has tabs (Lesson Content, Evaluation, Comments, Audit Trail)
Frontend: Evaluate and Publish buttons visible for approved lessons
critical_code_review_comments: Lessons V2 module is well-structured with proper separation of Staff and Management views
AI integration uses Gemini 2.0 Flash via emergentintegrations library
Proper role-based access control for management endpoints
Dual-role users (e.g., SuperAdmin with Teacher role) correctly see both Staff and Management tabs
Submit/Review workflow properly tracks status transitions and audit trail
Compliance tracker correctly calculates submission rates per teacher
